title: Figures 28-29: free-electron laser undulator illustration and FEL mechanism
description: Figure 28, "Free-Electron Laser," is a 3D illustration of an electron beam passing through an undulator of alternating N/S magnets, with a red-boxed close-up of the wiggling electron path and an orange output laser beam. Figure 29, "Free-Electron Laser Mechanism," schematically shows electron beam pulses passing through a wiggler between a "100 % reflecting mirror" and a "partially transmitting mirror," with photon emission producing optical laser pulses. Both are credited to the Naval Post-Graduate School FEL Lab and accompany text explaining how FELs generate coherent light.
